patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than Cisco Webex's shape. Choose Cisco Webex only if your buying job matches “Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Ca” rather than SaneBox's shape. Workflow advantage: SaneBox leans shared coverage; Cisco Webex leans business-phone, contact-center. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in business-communications, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages; Cisco Webex is Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Calling and Contact Center often quote-layered..
- Company-size focus: SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business) vs Cisco Webex (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: SaneBox-leaning — vs Cisco Webex-leaning business-phone, contact-center.
- Researched limits: SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Cisco Webex — Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic.

Limitations — SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost; Cisco Webex: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic; Full Calling + Contact Center depth is often EA/quote layered beyond Suite list floors.

Poor-fit cases: SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Cisco Webex is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic · Avoid SaneBox if you actually need Cisco Webex's motion (Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
